keyEvents.text: Will Lancaster (Fylde) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Harrogate Town 1, Fylde 0. Will McGowan (Harrogate Town) right footed shot. Assisted by Michael Craig.
Harvey Broad (Fylde) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Harrogate Town 1, Fylde 1. Luca Thomas (Fylde) right footed shot. Assisted by Millar Matthews-Lewis.
Sam Dreyer (Harrogate Town) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Harrogate Town 1, Fylde 2. Aaron Drewe (Fylde) right footed shot.
Archie Baptiste (Harrogate Town) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Harrogate Town 1, Fylde 3. Tom Whelan (Fylde) converts the penalty with a right footed shot.
Goal! Harrogate Town 1, Fylde 4. Millar Matthews-Lewis (Fylde) right footed shot. Assisted by Dylan Allen-Hadley.
